source.name: Deployment options
source.instructions: Open any large chat model's card (for example **GPT-4o mini** or **Mistral Large**) and look at its **deployment options**. Which option means *Microsoft hosts the model for you and you pay per use, without managing any servers*?

answers.answer: Managed compute — you reserve and pay for dedicated virtual machines
Downloading the model weights and running them on your laptop
Printing the model card and mailing it to Microsoft

source.guidance: With serverless (standard / pay-as-you-go) deployments you just call an API and pay per token — Microsoft runs the infrastructure. Managed compute gives you dedicated VMs for models that need them (more control, more cost). Model cards list which options each model supports.
